note: outside the 12 cells: the summit promenade of 亀山テラス360° (山頂駅 east along the ridge to ほしのてらす). The surface itself (terracotta ribbon, grey gravel edging, black railings) and the monorail cars and track are drawn in src/anime/world/landmarks/oshima.js (PROMENADE, buildOshima); this file clears the trees and the grown-over ground from a 12 m wide corridor round that line. APPROXIMATE route: traced from the pre-opening Earth strip of 2026-03-11; re-trace it from a post-July 2026 capture and add any spur from the station to terrace 1.
